summary.content:
Today's selection covers 65 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Meet the lawyer who beat Elon Musk — twice
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Critical SimpleHelp Vulnerability Exploited for Malware Delivery
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
